detailed_description:
The video is a cinematic, high-definition urban scene with a shallow depth of field and natural daylight lighting.
[Shot 1] The video begins exactly as the first frame of <Image 1>, where <Subject 1> stands on a busy city street, smiling at the camera while wearing sunglasses and a black turtleneck, holding her canvas tote bag. In the background, pedestrians walk and a yellow taxi is visible but blurred.
[Shot 2] At 00:00.000, the camera performs a smooth, slow orbit motion around <Subject 1> as she moves toward a parked dark car. She reaches up and naturally hooks the strap of her canvas tote bag over her left elbow. She then leans slightly toward the reflective glass of the car window. In the reflection, we see her holding <Subject 2>, the coral-colored lipstick. She checks the lipstick bullet in the reflection, adjusting her pose slightly. The sound includes a gust of wind blowing through the city buildings, the rustle of the canvas tote strap fluttering, and the distant hum of passing city traffic.
